name: Microsoft Copilot
pricingNote: Free tier on copilot.microsoft.com; Copilot Pro and Microsoft 365 Copilot are separate paid offers.
summary: Consumer Copilot chat at copilot.microsoft.com for web search, image creation, and everyday questions—not the same product page as Microsoft 365 Copilot for work.
description:
Microsoft Copilot on the web is the free-to-try assistant at copilot.microsoft.com. It answers questions, generates images, and helps with writing using Microsoft's latest models. Microsoft 365 Copilot is the paid work assistant embedded in Word, Excel, and Teams; this fiche covers the consumer web experience only.

Feature: Web-grounded answers with citations from Bing search. Feature: Image generation and editing in the Copilot chat. Feature: Voice and file upload on supported browsers. Feature: Sign-in with a personal Microsoft account for history sync.
